playstyle.identity: Taric is a protective enchanter/tank who makes his entire team invulnerable with his ultimate. His abilities can be cast through a linked ally.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive empowers next 2 autos after abilities. W links to ally (all abilities also cast from them). Q heals nearby allies. E stuns in a line (also from linked ally). R makes nearby allies invulnerable after a delay. Position well for double E stuns.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Taric spikes at level 6 with team invulnerability. Tank items make him durable. He's strong at teamfights with properly timed R.

passive.name: Bravado
passive.summary: After abilities, next 2 autos deal bonus damage and reduce cooldowns.
passive.details: After casting an ability, Taric's next 2 auto attacks deal bonus magic damage and reduce his basic ability cooldowns.

abilities.name: Starlight's Touch
abilities.summary: Heal nearby allies; stacks charges over time.
abilities.details: Taric heals himself and nearby allies. He stores charges over time and uses them for more powerful heals.

abilities.name: Bastion
abilities.summary: Link to an ally; your abilities also cast from their location.
abilities.details: Taric shields an ally and links to them. While linked, his Q, E, and R also cast from the ally's position.

abilities.name: Dazzle
abilities.summary: Charge and fire a beam that stuns; also casts from linked ally.
abilities.details: Taric fires a beam from himself (and his linked ally) that stuns enemies after a delay.

abilities.name: Cosmic Radiance
abilities.summary: After a delay, make yourself and nearby allies invulnerable.
abilities.details: Taric calls down cosmic energy. After a delay, he and all nearby allied champions become invulnerable for a few seconds.
